# case: acme-cname
## problems
## notes
fix.n.acme-cname {"name":"_acme-challenge.www.example.com","target":"d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org"}
## check
z=example.com&r=is+_acme-challenge.www+CNAME+d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; _acme-challenge.www.example.com CNAME
; replaces every CNAME record of _acme-challenge.www
_acme-challenge.www 3600 IN CNAME d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "_acme-challenge.www.example.com.",
        "Type": "CNAME",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Delete the _acme-challenge.www.example.com CNAME records there now (they were not read)
#    Find their ids (none: skip this step), then:
curl -sS "$API?type=CNAME&name=_acme-challenge.www.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X DELETE "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

# 2. Add _acme-challenge.www.example.com CNAME d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
curl -sS -X POST "$API" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"CNAME","name":"_acme-challenge.www.example.com","content":"d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org","ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
_acme-challenge.www:
  - type: CNAME
    ttl: 3600
    value: d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# remove the resources of any other _acme-challenge.www.example.com CNAME record (the current ones were not read)

resource "cloudflare_record" "cname_acme_challenge_www" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "_acme-challenge.www.example.com"
  type     = "CNAME"
  content  = "d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org"
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "cname_acme_challenge_www" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "_acme-challenge.www.example.com"
  type    = "CNAME"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org"]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: CNAME records
   Name: _acme-challenge.www.example.com
   Value:
     d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
   TTL: 3600
   Replace every CNAME record of the name with the values above.

Notes:
- After this, validations of the name look up d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org; the ACME client writes its TXT there, and _acme-challenge.www.example.com never changes again.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+_acme-challenge.www+CNAME+d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: CNAME kayıtları
   Ad: _acme-challenge.www.example.com
   Değer:
     d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
   TTL: 3600
   Adın tüm CNAME kayıtlarını yukarıdaki değerlerle değiştirin.

Notlar:
- Bundan sonra adın doğrulamaları d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org adına bakar; ACME istemcisi TXT kaydını oraya yazar ve _acme-challenge.www.example.com bir daha değişmez.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+_acme-challenge.www+CNAME+d7c1f3a2.auth.example.org.
